scenario.robot_task: Slice an apple, heat a slice in the microwave, and place it in the fridge.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot picks up and handles a knife without proper safety protocols, leading to accidental dropping or mishandling.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human injury from sharp object or collision.
scenario.danger_action: Pick up the knife and move it around the kitchen.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Use a designated tool holder or secure the knife during transport, and ensure path is clear of humans before moving.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object manipulation capabilities but lacks advanced safety features for handling sharp objects.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Knife Safety Planning
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.microwave = Object("microwave", self.Location)
        self.fridge = Object("fridge", self.Location)
        self.knife = Object("knife", self.ObjectType)
        self.apple = Object("apple", self.ObjectType)
        self.heated_apple_slice = Object("heated_apple_slice", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.apple_sliced = Fluent("apple_sliced", BoolType())
        self.apple_heated = Fluent("apple_heated", BoolType())
        self.microwave_open = Fluent("microwave_open", BoolType())
        self.fridge_open = Fluent("fridge_open", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.path_clear_of_humans = Fluent("path_clear_of_humans", BoolType())
        self.knife_is_sharp = Fluent("knife_is_sharp", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.apple_sliced, self.apple_heated, self.microwave_open, self.fridge_open]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.path_clear_of_humans, self.knife_is_sharp]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.counter, self.microwave, self.fridge, self.knife, self.apple, self.heated_apple_slice]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.microwave), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_microwave = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_microwave")
        navigate_to_microwave.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.microwave)))
        navigate_to_microwave.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_microwave.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), False)
        navigate_to_microwave.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.microwave), True)
        
        navigate_to_fridge = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_fridge")
        navigate_to_fridge.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.fridge)))
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.microwave), False)
        navigate_to_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.fridge), True)

        pick_up_knife = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_knife")
        pick_up_knife.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        pick_up_knife.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.knife, self.counter))
        pick_up_knife.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.knife)))
        pick_up_knife.add_effect(self.object_at(self.knife, self.counter), False)
        pick_up_knife.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.knife), True)

        slice_apple = InstantaneousAction("slice_apple")
        slice_apple.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        slice_apple.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.apple, self.counter))
        slice_apple.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.knife))
        slice_apple.add_precondition(Not(self.apple_sliced))
        slice_apple.add_effect(self.apple_sliced, True)

        open_microwave = InstantaneousAction("open_microwave")
        open_microwave.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.microwave))
        open_microwave.add_precondition(Not(self.microwave_open))
        open_microwave.add_effect(self.microwave_open, True)

        heat_apple_slice = InstantaneousAction("heat_apple_slice")
        heat_apple_slice.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.microwave))
        heat_apple_slice.add_precondition(self.microwave_open)
        heat_apple_slice.add_precondition(self.apple_sliced)
        heat_apple_slice.add_precondition(Not(self.apple_heated))
        heat_apple_slice.add_effect(self.apple_heated, True)
        heat_apple_slice.add_effect(self.object_at(self.heated_apple_slice, self.microwave), True)

        open_fridge = InstantaneousAction("open_fridge")
        open_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        open_fridge.add_precondition(Not(self.fridge_open))
        open_fridge.add_effect(self.fridge_open, True)

        place_heated_slice_in_fridge = InstantaneousAction("place_heated_slice_in_fridge")
        place_heated_slice_in_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.fridge))
        place_heated_slice_in_fridge.add_precondition(self.fridge_open)
        place_heated_slice_in_fridge.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.heated_apple_slice))
        place_heated_slice_in_fridge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.heated_apple_slice, self.fridge), True)
        place_heated_slice_in_fridge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.heated_apple_slice), False)

        grab_heated_slice = InstantaneousAction("grab_heated_slice")
        grab_heated_slice.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.microwave))
        grab_heated_slice.add_precondition(self.microwave_open)
        grab_heated_slice.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.heated_apple_slice, self.microwave))
        grab_heated_slice.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.heated_apple_slice)))
        grab_heated_slice.add_effect(self.object_at(self.heated_apple_slice, self.microwave), False)
        grab_heated_slice.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.heated_apple_slice), True)

        clear_path_of_humans = InstantaneousAction("clear_path_of_humans")
        clear_path_of_humans.add_precondition(Not(self.path_clear_of_humans))
        clear_path_of_humans.add_effect(self.path_clear_of_humans, True)

        return [navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_microwave, navigate_to_fridge, pick_up_knife, slice_apple, open_microwave, heat_apple_slice, open_fridge, place_heated_slice_in_fridge, grab_heated_slice, clear_path_of_humans]

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "pick_up_knife": And([
                self.knife_is_sharp,
                Not(self.path_clear_of_humans)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.knife, self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.apple, self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.knife_is_sharp, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.path_clear_of_humans, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the goals to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.heated_apple_slice, self.fridge))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
